info.name: Learn API (Jsonplaceholder)
info.description:
## Learn API (Jsonplaceholder)

This collection is a comprehensive set of API requests for learning and exploring the [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) API — a free, open-source fake REST API for testing and prototyping.

The collection covers full **CRUD operations** and **read operations** across all major resources provided by the API, including:

- 📝 **Posts** — Create, read, update, and delete post resources
- 💬 **Comments** — Retrieve comments and filter by post
- 👤 **Users** — Retrieve users and their associated posts, todos, and albums
- 🖼️ **Albums & Photos** — Retrieve albums and photos with filtering support
- ✅ **Todos** — Retrieve and update todo items with completion status filtering
- ⚠️ **Negative Tests** — Edge cases and error handling scenarios

Each request includes test scripts to validate response status codes, data structures, data types, and business logic. This collection is ideal for learning API testing fundamentals with Postman.

item.description:
## Posts

This folder covers full **CRUD operations** on the `/posts` endpoint of the [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) API. It includes requests to retrieve all posts, filter posts by `userId`, and fetch a single post by ID, as well as a nested endpoint to retrieve all comments belonging to a specific post. Post creation is tested both with static data and using **environment variables**, while update and delete operations validate the `PUT` and `DELETE` methods respectively.

## Todos

This folder covers **read and update operations** on the `/todos` endpoint of the [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) API. It includes requests to retrieve all todos, get a single todo by ID, filter todos by completion status (`completed=true` and `completed=false`), and update a todo's status via PATCH.

Each request is equipped with test scripts to validate response status, data structure, correct data types, and that filter or update values are correctly reflected in the response.

item.description:
## Negative Tests

This folder documents **error handling and edge case behavior** across multiple endpoints of the [JSONPlaceholder](https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com) API. It covers scenarios such as requesting resources with non-existent IDs, using string values as path parameters, sending requests with empty bodies, and filtering with invalid query parameters.

Each request is equipped with test scripts that validate the expected error responses — including `404 Not Found`, `500 Internal Server Error`, and unexpected `200 OK` behaviors — providing important findings about how the API handles invalid or missing data.
